title: OMNI-RRM: ADVANCING OMNI REWARD MODELING VIA AUTOMATIC RUBRIC-GROUNDED PREFERENCE SYNTHESIS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on multimodal understanding, reasoning, and alignment with human preferences in terms of fluency, relevance, accuracy, reasoning, and safety, without specifying religious contexts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
